summary: This January 20, 2026 World Game lecture is already foundational public evidence for The Borderland Engine and supporting evidence for Game Theory: it defines energy, openness, and cohesion; clarifies that poverty is not magic; and turns weak-player resource scarcity into a forecasting and power-audit method.

existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links the central triad to the Borderland Engine anchor, and the public page uses this source as the definitional base for the concept.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: poverty is not magic; scarcity becomes power only if it is organized into energy, openness, cohesion, learning, relationship, and strategic motion
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is already the public caveat that keeps the Borderland Engine from becoming a romantic claim that deprivation itself creates strength.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: a poor or defeated society needs a leader, poet, prophet, priest, thinker, or shared imagination to become one cohesive group
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links the formation claim to the atlas anchor, where civilizational capacity depends on organizing suffering or marginality into a people.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: this source defines the Borderland Engine's core diagnostic through the World Game classroom exercise, Qin/Athens/Macedon/Rome/Aztec examples, and the caveat that poverty must be organized into energy, openness, cohesion, learning, relationship, and motion.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The Borderland Engine owns the energy/openness/cohesion scorecard and the scarcity-to-motion caveat. Game Theory owns the payoff-board method; Prediction owns dated country forecasts; Power owns game-master rent extraction.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as source-trail and section evidence: the lecture says history must be read by asking what game the players are playing, how motivations and incentives change over time, and how factions inside a mature empire solve secrecy, trust, and coordination.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns the board audit, incentive change, and cheating/coordination logic. Secret Society owns durable hidden-trust institutions when the organization itself becomes primary; Borderland owns the margin's energetic scorecard.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the game-master answer for a future Power replacement pass: Jiang defines power as the ability to impose your game, make others play by your rules, and extract rent, then uses postwar Germany and Japan to separate wealth from sovereignty.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns imposed rule, rent extraction, and wealth-as-non-sovereignty. Prediction owns the later country-specific forecast status; Imperial Retrenchment owns American protector-to-extractor posture when the business model is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Record but do not promote the live country forecasts: Jiang says North Korea may have a better future than China under the energy/openness/cohesion model, and names Germany, Japan, and Israel as future great nations. These should be split into dated forecast families before any ledger work.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns the dated claims and later comparison. Borderland owns the diagnostic logic behind the claims; Nation owns national cohesion as a body; Eschatology owns Israel only when sacred role-script rather than civilizational scorecard is primary.

chronology_notes.note: On 2026-01-20, Jiang gives an explicit country-forecast cluster from the World Game model: North Korea over China as a future possibility, Germany and Japan as future great powers after defeat and humiliation, and Israel as a named future great nation.

The same source qualifies the World Game model: poverty or defeat alone does not create power; a leader, poet, prophet, priest, thinker, or shared imagination must unify deprivation into a cohesive people.

next_actions.action: No ordinary public Borderland append is needed; the source is already foundational on The Borderland Engine and linked from the episode read.

Before any Prediction ledger promotion, split the 2026-01-20 country claims into separate forecast families: North Korea/China future comparison, Germany resurgence, Japan East Asia dominance, and Israel future-great-nation status.
If Power gets a replacement pass, consider the game-master/rent-extraction definition as tighter evidence for the difference between wealth and sovereignty.
